threats.title: Access Token Tampering
threats.description: An attacker may modify token data or JWT claims in transit or attempt to manipulate the token to alter the AI agent's identity or authorization context.
threats.mitigation: Validate JWT signatures, issuer, audience, expiration, and scopes. Use HTTPS/TLS for token transmission.

threats.title: Access Token Disclosure
threats.description: An attacker may intercept or obtain the AI agent's access token, exposing sensitive identity and authorization information and potentially enabling unauthorized API access.
threats.mitigation: Use TLS, short-lived access tokens, secure token storage, least-privilege scopes, and prevent tokens from being exposed in logs or error messages.

threats.title: Token Service/Identity Flow Denial of Service
threats.description: An attacker may flood the authentication or token flow with excessive requests, preventing the AI agent from obtaining valid access tokens and disrupting access to protected services.
threats.mitigation: Apply rate limiting, abuse detection, request throttling, and monitoring around token issuance and authentication endpoints.
